award.quote: Application budgets are not limited but need to reflect the actual needs of the proposed budget.

sections.name: Research Strategy
sections.quote: Research Strategy: Factor 1. IMPORTANCE OF THE RESEARCH (SIGNIFICANCE AND INNOVATION) 1. Discuss how the results of the proposed work will lead to a firm conclusion about the tested hypothesis.

sections.name: Data Management and Sharing Plan (including NIMH Data Archive data sharing)
sections.quote: All applications, regardless of the amount of direct costs requested for any one year, must address a Data Management and Sharing Plan.

sections.name: Recruitment and Retention Plan
sections.component: Study Record: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information, Section 2.5
sections.quote: For studies involving human subjects, applications must provide a clear description of: 1. Recruitment and Referral sources,

sections.name: Study Timeline
sections.component: Study Record: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information, Section 2.7
sections.quote: Applications must provide a timeline for reaching important study benchmarks. Benchmarks should be objective, quantifiable, and justifiable.

criteria.name: Factor 1. Importance of the Research (Significance and Innovation)
criteria.quote: Factor 1. Importance of the Research (Significance and Innovation) Significance Evaluate the importance of the proposed research

criteria.name: Factor 2. Rigor and Feasibility (Approach)
criteria.quote: Evaluate the scientific quality of the proposed work. Evaluate the likelihood that compelling, reproducible findings will result (rigor)

criteria.name: Factor 3. Expertise and Resources (Investigator(s) and Environment)
criteria.quote: Factor 3. Expertise and Resources (Investigator(s) and Environment) Investigator(s) Evaluate whether the investigator(s) have demonstrated background

criteria.name: Protections for Human Subjects
criteria.quote: For research that involves human subjects but does not involve one of the categories of research that are exempt under 45 CFR Part 46

criteria.name: Vertebrate Animals
criteria.quote: When the proposed research includes Vertebrate Animals, evaluate the involvement of live vertebrate animals according to the following criteria

criteria.name: Biohazards
criteria.quote: When the proposed research includes Biohazards, evaluate whether specific materials or procedures that will be used are significantly hazardous

criteria.name: Resubmissions
criteria.quote: As applicable, evaluate the full application as now presented.

criteria.name: Renewals
criteria.quote: As applicable, evaluate the progress made in the last funding period.

criteria.name: Revisions
criteria.quote: As applicable, evaluate the appropriateness of the proposed expansion of the scope of the project.

criteria.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
criteria.quote: For projects involving key biological and/or chemical resources, evaluate the brief plans proposed for identifying and ensuring the validity of those resources.

criteria.name: Budget and Period of Support
criteria.quote: Evaluate whether the budget and the requested period of support are fully justified and reasonable in relation to the proposed research.

other: Follow the Research (R) Instructions in the How to Apply - Application Guide; page limits per the Application Guide and the Table of Page Limits
Only limited Appendix materials are allowed: no publications or other material except blank questionnaires or blank surveys
Applications must be submitted electronically; paper applications will not be accepted
format.quote: All page limitations described in the How to Apply-Application Guide

eligibility.item: Eligible organizations: higher education institutions; nonprofits; for-profit organizations including small businesses; state, county, city/township, special district and tribal governments; eligible federal agencies; U.S. territories; independent school districts; public/Indian housing authorities; tribal organizations; faith- or community-based organizations; regional organizations; and non-domestic (foreign) entities
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) Entities (Foreign Organizations) are eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Non-domestic components of U.S. organizations are eligible, and foreign components are allowed
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) components of U.S. Organizations are eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Any individual with the skills, knowledge, and resources to carry out the research may serve as PD/PI with their organization; multiple PD/PIs allowed
eligibility.quote: Any individual(s) with the skills, knowledge, and resources necessary to carry out the proposed research as the Program Director(s)/Principal Investigator(s) (PD(s)/PI(s)) is invited to work with their organization

eligibility.item: Applications must not propose clinical trials (must not prospectively assign participants to interventions)
eligibility.quote: Not Allowed: Only accepting applications that do not propose clinical trials.

eligibility.item: Applications must include mental health services research
eligibility.quote: Applications that do not include mental health services research.

eligibility.item: Applications whose scope primarily involves provision of direct services (e.g., creating a clinic or center) are non-responsive
eligibility.quote: Applications whose scope of work primarily involves the provision of direct services (e.g., the creation of a clinic or center).

eligibility.item: Applications must have clearly articulated relevance to people with or at risk for mental illness or autism spectrum disorder
eligibility.quote: Applications that have no clearly articulated relevance to people with or who are at risk for mental illness or autism spectrum disorder.

eligibility.item: Stigma or health literacy studies are non-responsive unless they also examine mental health policy, service access, engagement, quality and/or outcomes of care
eligibility.quote: Studies focused on stigma or health literacy that examine knowledge about or attitudes towards mental health and mental health care without also examining mental health policy,

eligibility.item: Only New, Renewal, Resubmission, or Revision application types are allowed
eligibility.quote: Only those application types listed here are allowed for this NOFO.

eligibility.item: Organizations may submit more than one application only if each is scientifically distinct
eligibility.quote: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided that each application is scientifically distinct.

eligibility.item: A new (A0) application is not accepted before the summary statement issues for an overlapping A0 or A1 application
eligibility.quote: A new (A0) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of an overlapping new (A0) or resubmission (A1) application.

eligibility.item: A resubmission (A1) is not accepted before the summary statement issues for the previous A0 application
eligibility.quote: A resubmission (A1) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of the previous new (A0) application.

eligibility.item: An application substantially overlapping another application pending appeal of initial peer review is not accepted
eligibility.quote: An application that has substantial overlap with another application pending appeal of initial peer review

eligibility.item: Applicants requesting $500,000 or more in direct costs in any year must contact a Scientific/Research Contact at least 6 weeks before submitting
eligibility.quote: Applicants requesting $500,000 or more in direct costs in any year (excluding consortium F&A) must contact a Scientific/ Research Contact at least 6 weeks before submitting the application

eligibility.item: All organizational registrations (SAM, UEI, eRA Commons, Grants.gov) must be completed before the application is submitted (allow 6 weeks or more)
eligibility.quote: All registrations must be completed prior to the application being submitted. Registration can take 6 weeks or more

eligibility.item: Maintain an active SAM registration, renewed at least annually
eligibility.quote: Applicants must complete and maintain an active registration, which requires renewal at least annually.

eligibility.item: Foreign organizations must obtain an NCAGE code to register in SAM
eligibility.quote: Foreign organizations must obtain an NCAGE code (in lieu of a CAGE code) in order to register in SAM.

eligibility.item: Use the same UEI for all registrations and on the grant application
eligibility.quote: The same UEI must be used for all registrations, as well as on the grant application.

eligibility.item: Organization must register in eRA Commons with at least one Signing Official and one PD/PI account
eligibility.quote: Commons requires organizations to identify at least one Signing Official (SO) and at least one Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI) account in order to submit an application.

eligibility.item: Organization must complete Grants.gov registration (requires active SAM registration)
eligibility.quote: Applicants must have an active SAM registration in order to complete the Grants.gov registration.

eligibility.item: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account affiliated with the applicant organization
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account. PD(s)/PI(s) should work with their organizational officials to either create a new account or to affiliate their existing account

eligibility.item: A PD/PI who is also the organizational Signing Official must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts
eligibility.quote: If the PD/PI is also the organizational Signing Official, they must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts, one for each role.

eligibility.item: All PD(s)/PI(s) must enter their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must include their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form.

requiredDocuments.item: R&R or Modular Budget, with budget justification

requiredDocuments.quote: R&R Subaward Budget All instructions in the How to Apply-Application Guide must be followed.

requiredDocuments.item: At least one human subjects study record (or Delayed Onset Study record) on the PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form if human subjects are involved
requiredDocuments.quote: you must include at least one human subjects study record using the Study Record: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form or Delayed Onset Study record.
